name: Stripe Payments
rationale: Stripe integrations are high-blast-radius payment code and must keep checkout creation, webhook verification, and secret keys server-only.

directories.purpose: Server-owned payment, checkout, billing, and webhook workflows.

fileRules.name: Stripe Payment Server Boundary
fileRules.rule: Checkout sessions, webhook verification, and Stripe secret keys must stay behind server-owned payment modules.
fileRules.trigger: A UI file imports Stripe/payment modules or any file reads Stripe/payment env vars outside a server boundary.
fileRules.recommendation: Move payment work to src/server/payments and expose only safe client actions or API routes.
fileRules.goodExample: src/server/payments/createCheckoutSession.ts owns Stripe SDK calls and returns a redirect URL.
fileRules.badExample: A client component imports Stripe SDK server helpers or reads STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.

detectors.description: Flags Stripe/payment imports in UI and payment secret env access.

moduleBoundaries: Payment mutations and webhook verification are server-owned.
UI can start safe checkout flows but must not construct privileged Stripe requests.
testingExpectations: Add tests or documented verification for checkout creation, webhook verification, and failed-payment paths.
agentInstructions: Do not change payment behavior, products, prices, or webhook handling without a pre-edit contract and explicit verification.
